plan.title: Live RFQ Extend Time Without Option

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ project without creating or searching for another event.
Open the RFQ stage required for the Responses and Settings flow.
Navigate to the Responses tab specified by the case.
Open the Increase Event Time dialog from the RFQ Settings menu.
Confirm the expected time-extension dialog is open before clearing its options.
Ensure the 15-minute radio option is not selected.
Ensure the 30-minute radio option is not selected.
Ensure the one-hour radio option is not selected.
Submit the dialog with no duration option selected.
Verify that the dialog remains open instead of completing the time extension.
Check that no server error or page crash is shown after the rejected submission.
